===FILE-ESC: extract/tests/verify_strategy_outputs.sh===
===META: mode=644 sha256=3fc78dd6a6b7ab37729f3a1b58f8bf073ca5145ad8fdc1b492f32ce26d6b87b0===
#!/bin/bash
################################################################################
## Golden Output Verification for all strategies
##
## Runs each strategy against its first sample file and compares to a stored
## "golden" snapshot.  This catches silent regressions where extraction logic
## changes but tests still pass because they only check for presence of fields.
##
## Usage:
##   bash verify_strategy_outputs.sh [--update] [--check] [--strategy NAME]
##
##   --update          Write current output as the baseline (run once to capture)
##   --check           Compare current output to baseline (default)
##   --strategy NAME   Verify only the named strategy (repeatable)
##   --verbose         Print PASS lines as well as FAIL
##
## Golden files are stored in: tests/golden/<strategy-name>.txt
################################################################################

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
MFE_SCRIPT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)/envoy-extract"
SAMPLES_DIR="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)/samples"
STRATEGIES_DIR="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)/strategies"
GOLDEN_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/golden"

mode="check"
opt_strategy_filter=()
opt_verbose=0

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        --update)   mode="update"; shift ;;
        --check)    mode="check"; shift ;;
        --strategy) opt_strategy_filter+=("$2"); shift 2 ;;
        --verbose)  opt_verbose=1; shift ;;
        *) echo "Unknown option: $1" >&2; exit 1 ;;
    esac
done

# Colors (if terminal supports them)
if [[ -t 1 ]]; then
    GREEN='\033[0;32m'; RED='\033[0;31m'; YELLOW='\033[0;33m'; NC='\033[0m'
else
    GREEN=''; RED=''; YELLOW=''; NC=''
fi

TOTAL=0; PASSED=0; FAILED=0; SKIPPED=0
FAILED_NAMES=()

mkdir -p "$GOLDEN_DIR"

################################################################################
## _first_sample_file <strategy_name>
## Echoes the path to the first sample file for a strategy, or nothing.
_first_sample_file () {
    local name="$1"
    local sdir="$SAMPLES_DIR/$name"
    [[ -d "$sdir" ]] || return 1
    local f
    for f in "$sdir"/*; do
        [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
        case "$f" in
            *.md|*/HANDOFF.md) continue ;;
        esac
        echo "$f"
        return 0
    done
    return 1
}

################################################################################
## _get_all_strategies
## Echoes all strategy names (from ## Name: headers) sorted alphabetically.
_get_all_strategies () {
    local strat_file strat_name
    for strat_file in "$STRATEGIES_DIR"/*/*.sh; do
        [[ -f "$strat_file" ]] || continue
        strat_name=""
        while IFS= read -r _line; do
            case "$_line" in
                "## Name: "*) strat_name="${_line#\#\# Name: }"; break ;;
            esac
        done < "$strat_file"
        [[ -n "$strat_name" ]] && echo "$strat_name"
    done | sort
}

################################################################################
## _run_strategy <name> <sample_file>
## Runs mfe with the strategy and plain format. Outputs to stdout.
_run_strategy () {
    local name="$1"
    local sample="$2"
    bash "$MFE_SCRIPT" --strategy "$name" --format plain --raw "$sample" 2>/dev/null \
        | grep -v '^STRAT-' \
        | sed 's/^[A-Z_-]*:[0-9]*	//'
    # Strip any remaining STRAT prefix in case -r flag exposes them
}

################################################################################
## _normalize_output <text>
## Normalize output for comparison: strip STRAT prefix lines, sort lines
## (strategies may emit fields in any order depending on file system).
_normalize_output () {
    echo "$1" | grep -v '^$' | sort
}

################################################################################
## Determine list of strategies to test
if [[ ${#opt_strategy_filter[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    all_strategies=("${opt_strategy_filter[@]}")
else
    mapfile -t all_strategies < <(_get_all_strategies)
fi

if [[ "$mode" == "update" ]]; then
    echo "========================================"
    echo "Golden Output Update Mode"
    echo "Writing baselines to: $GOLDEN_DIR/"
    echo "========================================"
else
    echo "========================================"
    echo "Golden Output Verification"
    echo "========================================"
fi

for strat_name in "${all_strategies[@]}"; do
    TOTAL=$((TOTAL + 1))

    # Find sample file
    sample_file=""
    sample_file=$(_first_sample_file "$strat_name") || true

    if [[ -z "$sample_file" ]]; then
        SKIPPED=$((SKIPPED + 1))
        [[ $opt_verbose -eq 1 ]] && printf "  %sSKIP%s: %s (no sample dir)\n" "$YELLOW" "$NC" "$strat_name"
        continue
    fi

    golden_file="$GOLDEN_DIR/${strat_name}.txt"

    # Run extraction
    current_output=$(bash "$MFE_SCRIPT" --strategy "$strat_name" --format plain "$sample_file" 2>/dev/null || true)

    if [[ "$mode" == "update" ]]; then
        echo "$current_output" > "$golden_file"
        printf "  %sWROTE%s: %s Aje28692Aj %s fields\n" "$GREEN" "$NC" "$strat_name" "$(echo "$current_output" | grep -c .)"
        PASSED=$((PASSED + 1))
        continue
    fi

    # Check mode: compare to golden
    if [[ ! -f "$golden_file" ]]; then
        SKIPPED=$((SKIPPED + 1))
        printf "  %sSKIP%s: %s (no golden file Aje28094Aj run --update first)\n" "$YELLOW" "$NC" "$strat_name"
        continue
    fi

    golden_content=$(cat "$golden_file")

    # Normalize both for comparison (sort fields Aje28094Aj order may vary)
    current_norm=$(_normalize_output "$current_output")
    golden_norm=$(_normalize_output "$golden_content")

    if [[ "$current_norm" == "$golden_norm" ]]; then
        PASSED=$((PASSED + 1))
        [[ $opt_verbose -eq 1 ]] && printf "  %sPASS%s: %s\n" "$GREEN" "$NC" "$strat_name"
    else
        FAILED=$((FAILED + 1))
        FAILED_NAMES+=("$strat_name")
        printf "  %sFAIL%s: %s\n" "$RED" "$NC" "$strat_name"
        # Show diff (first 10 lines)
        echo "    Expected (golden):"
        echo "$golden_norm" | head -5 | sed 's/^/      /'
        echo "    Actual (current):"
        echo "$current_norm" | head -5 | sed 's/^/      /'
    fi
done

echo ""
echo "========================================"
if [[ "$mode" == "update" ]]; then
    echo "Updated: $PASSED baselines written, $SKIPPED skipped (no sample)"
else
    echo "Results: $PASSED passed, $FAILED failed, $SKIPPED skipped"
    if [[ $FAILED -gt 0 ]]; then
        printf "%sFailed strategies:%s\n" "$RED" "$NC"
        for n in "${FAILED_NAMES[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $n"
        done
        echo "========================================"
        exit 1
    else
        printf "%sAll verified strategies match golden output.%s\n" "$GREEN" "$NC"
    fi
fi
echo "========================================"
===END===

===FILE: extract/tools/HANDOFF.md===
===META: mode=644 sha256=e5b65d6014f7b61c82e3a52d8747fda981a5ef281467bbc3ef5e64626fdaa3a8===
# Handoff -- EnvoyExtract/tools

## Purpose

Developer tools for creating and verifying EnvoyExtract strategies. These are not part of the runtime extraction pipeline; they assist strategy authors during development.

## Tools

### new_strategy.sh -- Strategy Scaffolding

Auto-generates a strategy stub from a sample file with proper headers and function stubs.

**Usage:**
```
new_strategy.sh --name NAME --category CATEGORY --sample FILE [OPTIONS]
```

**What it creates:**
- `strategies/<category>/<name>.sh` -- strategy file with `strategy_detect()` and `strategy_extract()` stubs, proper metadata headers, and detect hints from the sample file
- `samples/<name>/sample1.txt` -- copy of the provided sample file

**Options:** `--description`, `--priority`, `--technique`, `--version`, `--force`

### review_strategy.sh -- Strategy Review (Human Spot-Check)

Interactive workflow for verifying a strategy's extraction accuracy against its sample file.

**Usage:**
```
review_strategy.sh STRATEGY_NAME [OPTIONS]
```

**Workflow:**
1. Finds the strategy file and its sample
2. Runs extraction with `envoy-extract -s NAME -r SAMPLE`
3. For each extracted field, prompts accept/reject/skip
4. Outputs an accuracy report (percentage of accepted vs rejected)

**Options:** `--sample FILE` (override), `--auto` (non-interactive), `--format csv|text`

## Next Steps

- Add batch review mode (review multiple strategies in sequence)
- Add golden output comparison (diff against expected output files)
- Integrate with `envoy-extract validate` for comprehensive strategy health checks
===END===

stubs, plus a corresponding sample directory.

Required:
  --name NAME           Strategy name (lowercase, hyphenated, e.g. "my-format")

Options:
  --description TEXT    Short description of the strategy (default: auto-generated)
  --priority N          Priority value 1-99 (default: 50)
  --version VER         Initial version (default: 1.0)

Output:
  Creates:
    strategies/<category>/<name>.sh    Strategy file with detect/extract stubs
    samples/<name>/                    Sample directory

  new_strategy.sh --name my-logs --category logging --sample /tmp/app.log

}

opt_sample=""

opt_priority=50

        --sample)

            opt_sample="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --description)
            [[ $# -lt 2 ]] && echo "error: --description requires an argument" >&2 && exit 1
            opt_description="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --priority)
            [[ $# -lt 2 ]] && echo "error: --priority requires an argument" >&2 && exit 1
            opt_priority="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --version)
            [[ $# -lt 2 ]] && echo "error: --version requires an argument" >&2 && exit 1
            opt_version="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --force)
            opt_force=1; shift ;;
        *)
            echo "error: unknown option: $1" >&2; exit 1 ;;
    esac
done

# Validate required arguments
if [[ -z "$opt_name" ]]; then
    echo "error: --name is required" >&2
    echo "Run 'new_strategy.sh --help' for usage." >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [[ -z "$opt_category" ]]; then
    echo "error: --category is required" >&2
    echo "Run 'new_strategy.sh --help' for usage." >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [[ -z "$opt_sample" ]]; then
    echo "error: --sample is required" >&2

# Validate name format (lowercase, hyphenated, no spaces)
if [[ ! "$opt_name" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ ]]; then

===FILE: extract/tools/review_strategy.sh===

#!/bin/bash
################################################################################
## Strategy Review Tool for EnvoyExtract
##
## Human spot-check workflow: runs a strategy against its sample file, shows
## detected fields and values, and asks the user to confirm/reject each field.
## Outputs an accuracy report at the end.
##
## Usage: review_strategy.sh STRATEGY_NAME [OPTIONS]
##        review_strategy.sh --help
##
## Developed by SageCor Solutions, Annapolis Junction, MD
################################################################################

set -eo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
EXTRACT_DIR="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
MFE_SCRIPT="$EXTRACT_DIR/envoy-extract"

usage () {
    cat <<'EOF'
Strategy Review Tool (review_strategy.sh)

Usage: review_strategy.sh STRATEGY_NAME [OPTIONS]

Runs a strategy against its sample file and walks the user through each
extracted field for human verification. Outputs an accuracy report.

Arguments:
  STRATEGY_NAME         Name of the strategy to review (e.g. "json", "syslog")

Options:
  --sample FILE         Override the sample file (default: use strategy's ## Sample: header)
  --auto                Non-interactive mode: just show all fields without prompting
  --format FMT          Output report format: text (default), csv
  -h, --help            Show this help

Interactive Controls:
  y/Enter               Accept field as correct
  n                     Reject field as incorrect
  s                     Skip field (neither correct nor incorrect)
  q                     Quit review early and show partial report

Examples:
  review_strategy.sh json
  review_strategy.sh syslog --sample /tmp/my-syslog.log
  review_strategy.sh csv --auto
EOF
}

# Defaults
opt_strategy=""
opt_sample=""
opt_auto=0
opt_format="text"

# Parse arguments
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        -h|--help)
            usage; exit 0 ;;
        --sample)
            [[ $# -lt 2 ]] && echo "error: --sample requires an argument" >&2 && exit 1
            opt_sample="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --auto)
            opt_auto=1; shift ;;
        --format)
            [[ $# -lt 2 ]] && echo "error: --format requires an argument" >&2 && exit 1
            opt_format="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        -*)
            echo "error: unknown option: $1" >&2; exit 1 ;;
        *)
            if [[ -z "$opt_strategy" ]]; then
                opt_strategy="$1"; shift
            else
                echo "error: unexpected argument: $1" >&2; exit 1
            fi
            ;;
    esac
done

if [[ -z "$opt_strategy" ]]; then
    echo "error: strategy name is required" >&2
    echo "Run 'review_strategy.sh --help' for usage." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Find strategy file
strategy_file=""
for sf in "$EXTRACT_DIR/strategies"/*/"${opt_strategy}.sh" "$EXTRACT_DIR/strategies/${opt_strategy}.sh"; do
    if [[ -f "$sf" ]]; then
        strategy_file="$sf"
        break
    fi
done

if [[ -z "$strategy_file" ]]; then
    echo "error: strategy not found: $opt_strategy" >&2
    echo "Available strategies:" >&2
    bash "$MFE_SCRIPT" list 2>&1 | head -20 >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "Strategy file: $strategy_file"

# Read strategy metadata for sample path
if [[ -z "$opt_sample" ]]; then
    # Parse ## Sample: header from strategy file
    n=0
    while IFS= read -r meta_line; do
        n=$((n + 1))
        [[ $n -gt 15 ]] && break
        case "$meta_line" in
            '## Sample: '*)
                opt_sample="${meta_line#'## Sample: '}"
                # Resolve relative to EXTRACT_DIR
                if [[ "${opt_sample:0:1}" != "/" ]]; then
                    opt_sample="$EXTRACT_DIR/$opt_sample"
                fi
                ;;
        esac
    done < "$strategy_file"
fi

if [[ -z "$opt_sample" ]]; then
    echo "error: no sample file found in strategy header and none provided via --sample" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -f "$opt_sample" ]]; then
    echo "error: sample file not found: $opt_sample" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "Sample file: $opt_sample"
echo ""

# Run extraction
echo "Running strategy '$opt_strategy' against sample..."
extraction_output=""
extraction_rc=0
extraction_output=$(bash "$MFE_SCRIPT" -s "$opt_strategy" -r "$opt_sample" 2>/dev/null) || extraction_rc=$?

if [[ -z "$extraction_output" ]]; then
    echo "No fields extracted. The strategy did not match or produced no output."
    echo ""
    echo "=== Review Report ==="
    echo "Strategy: $opt_strategy"
    echo "Sample: $opt_sample"
    echo "Result: NO FIELDS EXTRACTED"
    echo "Exit code: $extraction_rc"
    exit 1
fi

# Count fields
total_fields=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
    [[ -n "$line" ]] && total_fields=$((total_fields + 1))
done <<< "$extraction_output"

echo "Extracted $total_fields field(s)."
echo ""

# Review each field
accepted=0
rejected=0
skipped=0
field_reports=""
field_num=0

while IFS= read -r field_line; do
    [[ -z "$field_line" ]] && continue
    field_num=$((field_num + 1))

    # Strip strategy prefix if present
    clean_line="$field_line"
    case "$clean_line" in
        STRAT-*) clean_line="${clean_line#*	}" ;;
    esac

    # Parse field name and value
    field_name="${clean_line%% *}"
    field_value="${clean_line#* }"

    if [[ $opt_auto -eq 1 ]]; then
        # Non-interactive: just show the field
        printf "  [%d/%d] %-30s = %s\n" "$field_num" "$total_fields" "$field_name" "$field_value"
        skipped=$((skipped + 1))
        field_reports="${field_reports}SKIP ${field_name} ${field_value}"$'\n'
        continue
    fi

    # Interactive: show and prompt
    echo "--- Field $field_num/$total_fields ---"
    printf "  Name:  %s\n" "$field_name"
    printf "  Value: %s\n" "$field_value"

    # Read from /dev/tty for interactive input (even when stdin is redirected)
    if [[ -t 0 ]] || [[ -e /dev/tty ]]; then
        printf "  Accept? [Y/n/s/q] "
        if [[ -t 0 ]]; then
            read -r response
        else
            read -r response < /dev/tty
        fi
    else
        echo "  (non-interactive: skipping)"
        response="s"
    fi

    case "${response:-y}" in
        y|Y|"")
            accepted=$((accepted + 1))
            field_reports="${field_reports}OK   ${field_name} ${field_value}"$'\n'
            echo "  -> Accepted"
            ;;
        n|N)
            rejected=$((rejected + 1))
            field_reports="${field_reports}FAIL ${field_name} ${field_value}"$'\n'
            echo "  -> Rejected"
            ;;
        s|S)
            skipped=$((skipped + 1))
            field_reports="${field_reports}SKIP ${field_name} ${field_value}"$'\n'
            echo "  -> Skipped"
            ;;
        q|Q)
            echo "  -> Quit early"
            break
            ;;
        *)
            skipped=$((skipped + 1))
            field_reports="${field_reports}SKIP ${field_name} ${field_value}"$'\n'
            echo "  -> Skipped (unrecognized input)"
            ;;
    esac
    echo ""
done <<< "$extraction_output"

# Compute accuracy
reviewed=$((accepted + rejected))
if [[ $reviewed -gt 0 ]]; then
    # Integer arithmetic for percentage
    accuracy=$(( (accepted * 100) / reviewed ))
else
    accuracy="N/A"
fi

echo ""

if [[ "$opt_format" == "csv" ]]; then
    # CSV report
    echo "strategy,sample,total_fields,accepted,rejected,skipped,accuracy"
    echo "${opt_strategy},${opt_sample},${total_fields},${accepted},${rejected},${skipped},${accuracy}"
else
    # Text report
    echo "=== Review Report ==="
    echo "Strategy:  $opt_strategy"
    echo "Sample:    $opt_sample"
    echo "Total:     $total_fields field(s)"
    echo "Accepted:  $accepted"
    echo "Rejected:  $rejected"
    echo "Skipped:   $skipped"
    if [[ "$accuracy" != "N/A" ]]; then
        echo "Accuracy:  ${accuracy}%"
    else
        echo "Accuracy:  N/A (no fields reviewed)"
    fi
    echo ""
    echo "--- Field Details ---"
    if [[ -n "$field_reports" ]]; then
        printf '%s' "$field_reports"
    fi
    echo "====================="
fi
===END===

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# glean Aje28094Aj turn command output into data.
#
# PROTOTYPE (proposal 0001). Implements the product's one path Aje28094Aj capture a
# command's output, auto-detect its format, present it as a tidy, one-row-per-
# record dataset Aje28094Aj on a git-backed store:
#
#     glean run <cmd>        execute a binary, capture its output as a commit
#     cmd | glean            inject stdin the same way
#     glean source <N>       show the original source data behind dataset row #N
#     glean log / restore    list captures / bring a capture's commit back up
#     glean ls / show        list datasets / present one as a tidy table
#     glean stats            (pending) statistics on a dataset
#
# The extract engine (all strategies) is bundled in this repo at glean/extract/.
#
# STORE MODEL (Stage A): the workspace is a git repo. By default captures go to
# a GLOBAL store (~/.glean, override with GLEAN_HOME) so you can capture from any
# directory. Every dataset row carries a globally-unique visible index (#N);
# `glean source N` maps it back to the exact captured input that produced it.
# The store may be shared by multiple users (point GLEAN_HOME at a shared,
# group-writable dir); a mkdir-based lock serialises concurrent writers.
#
set -euo pipefail

GLEAN_VERSION="0.7.0-proto"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Config (env-overridable; GLEAN_* is the post-rename namespace)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Workspace resolution:
#   1. $GLEAN_WORKSPACE explicit override (used by tests / one-off stores)
#   2. else the global store: $GLEAN_HOME, or ~/.glean
# (Stage B will insert "a controlled directory found by walking up from CWD"
#  between these two.)
_default_home () { printf '%s\n' "${GLEAN_HOME:-$HOME/.glean}"; }

# The real directory of this script, following symlinks Aje28094Aj so glean finds its
# bundled extract/analyze/transform trees even when invoked via a symlink on
# PATH (e.g. after install.sh). Computed once; used by all path resolvers.
_glean_root () {
    local src="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" d
    if command -v readlink >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        src="$(readlink -f "$src" 2>/dev/null || echo "$src")"
    fi
    while [[ -L "$src" ]]; do
        d="$(cd -P "$(dirname "$src")" && pwd)"; src="$(readlink "$src")"
        [[ "$src" != /* ]] && src="$d/$src"
    done
    cd -P "$(dirname "$src")" && pwd
}
GLEAN_ROOT="$(_glean_root)"

# A controlled directory holds its instance at <dir>/.glean with a CONTROLLED
# marker (which the global store lacks). Walk up from $start to find one.
_find_controlling_dir () {
    local here="$1"
    here="$(cd "$here" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || return 1
    while [[ -n "$here" && "$here" != "/" ]]; do
        [[ -f "$here/.glean/CONTROLLED" ]] && { printf '%s\n' "$here"; return 0; }
        here="$(dirname "$here")"
    done
    [[ -f "/.glean/CONTROLLED" ]] && { printf '/\n'; return 0; }
    return 1
}

# Resolve the active store:
#   1. $GLEAN_WORKSPACE explicit override
#   2. a controlled directory found by walking up from CWD
#   3. the global store ($GLEAN_HOME / ~/.glean)
GLEAN_WORKSPACE_EXPLICIT="${GLEAN_WORKSPACE:+1}"
if [[ -n "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE_EXPLICIT" ]]; then
    GLEAN_STORE_KIND="explicit override"
else
    _ctl="$(_find_controlling_dir "$PWD" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ -n "$_ctl" ]]; then
        GLEAN_WORKSPACE="$_ctl/.glean"; GLEAN_STORE_KIND="controlled: $_ctl"
    else
        GLEAN_WORKSPACE="$(_default_home)"; GLEAN_STORE_KIND="global"
    fi
    unset _ctl
fi
GLEAN_MIN_CONFIDENCE="${GLEAN_MIN_CONFIDENCE:-50}"
GLEAN_MAX_INPUT="${GLEAN_MAX_INPUT:-10485760}"   # 10 MiB
GLEAN_TEMP_DIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
GLEAN_LOCK_TIMEOUT="${GLEAN_LOCK_TIMEOUT:-30}"   # seconds to wait for the store lock
GLEAN_RECONCILE_OVERLAP="${GLEAN_RECONCILE_OVERLAP:-60}"  # % column overlap to union vs split a variant

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tiny UI helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
_is_tty () { [[ -t 2 ]]; }
if _is_tty; then C_OK=$'\033[32m'; C_DIM=$'\033[2m'; C_ERR=$'\033[31m'; C_RST=$'\033[0m'
else C_OK=""; C_DIM=""; C_ERR=""; C_RST=""; fi
info () { [[ "${GLEAN_QUIET:-0}" -eq 1 ]] || printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; }
ok ()   { [[ "${GLEAN_QUIET:-0}" -eq 1 ]] || printf '%s ok%s %s\n' "$C_OK" "$C_RST" "$*" >&2; }
die ()  { printf '%serror%s %s\n' "$C_ERR" "$C_RST" "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Locate the extract engine. It is bundled in this repo at glean/extract/ with
# its shared libs at glean/lib/ (the engine's ../lib). GLEAN_HOME can override.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
_find_engine () {
    local script_dir="$GLEAN_ROOT"
    local candidates=(
        "${GLEAN_HOME:-}/extract/envoy-extract"
        "$script_dir/extract/envoy-extract"       # bundled (canonical)
    )
    local c
    for c in "${candidates[@]}"; do
        [[ -n "$c" && -f "$c" ]] && { printf '%s\n' "$c"; return 0; }
    done
    return 1
}

# Locate the analyze engine (bundled at glean/analyze/). GLEAN_HOME can override.
_find_analyze () {
    local script_dir="$GLEAN_ROOT"
    local candidates=(
        "${GLEAN_HOME:-}/analyze/envoy-analyze"
        "$script_dir/analyze/envoy-analyze"       # bundled (canonical)
    )
    local c
    for c in "${candidates[@]}"; do
        [[ -n "$c" && -f "$c" ]] && { printf '%s\n' "$c"; return 0; }
    done
    return 1
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Transform layer Aje28094Aj the tidy melt (`_core_melt_tidy`) and schema-union helpers
# (`_core_union_header`, `_core_align_rows`) live in glean/transform/melt.sh.
# Source it now.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
_source_transform () {
    local script_dir="$GLEAN_ROOT"
    local candidates=(
        "${GLEAN_HOME:-}/transform/melt.sh"
        "$script_dir/transform/melt.sh"           # bundled (canonical)
    )
    local c
    for c in "${candidates[@]}"; do
        [[ -n "$c" && -r "$c" ]] && { source "$c"; return 0; }
    done
    die "transform module not found (expected at $script_dir/transform/melt.sh)."
}
_source_transform

_ds_dir ()  { printf '%s/datasets\n' "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE"; }
_cap_dir () { printf '%s/captures\n' "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE"; }
_prov_file ()  { printf '%s/provenance.tsv\n' "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE"; }
_rowid_file () { printf '%s/.next_row_id\n' "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE"; }

# git wrapper Aje28094Aj pinned identity + no signing, so commits work in any environment.
_git () { git -C "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE" -c user.name=glean -c user.email=glean@localhost -c commit.gpgsign=false "$@"; }

# --- store lock (a shared GLEAN_HOME may have concurrent writers) ----------
# mkdir is atomic across processes/users; spin up to GLEAN_LOCK_TIMEOUT seconds.
# Record $BASHPID (this process), NOT $$: a detached async ingest runs in a
# subshell where $$ is still the already-exited parent glean, and the stale-lock
# breaker would then see a "dead" owner and steal a live lock mid-write.
_lock () {
    local lock="$GLEAN_WORKSPACE/.lock" waited=0 pid
    while ! mkdir "$lock" 2>/dev/null; do
        pid="$(cat "$lock/pid" 2>/dev/null || echo)"
        if [[ -n "$pid" ]] && ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
            rm -rf "$lock" 2>/dev/null; continue   # break a stale lock
        fi
        waited=$((waited + 1))
        [[ $waited -ge $((GLEAN_LOCK_TIMEOUT * 5)) ]] && die "store is locked (waited ${GLEAN_LOCK_TIMEOUT}s): $lock"
        sleep 0.2
    done
    echo "$BASHPID" > "$lock/pid"
}
_unlock () { rm -rf "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE/.lock" 2>/dev/null || true; }

# The workspace is a git repo: every capture is one commit (tagged capture-NNNN),
# so a run can be brought back up later with `glean restore`. Initialization is
# serialised with double-checked locking so concurrent first-writers to a shared
# store don't race on `git init`.
_ensure_workspace () {
    mkdir -p "$(_ds_dir)" "$(_cap_dir)"
    if [[ ! -d "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE/.git" || ! -f "$(_rowid_file)" ]]; then
        _lock
        if [[ ! -d "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE/.git" ]]; then
            _git init -q
            printf 'glean workspace (store model %s)\n' "$GLEAN_VERSION" > "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE/.gleanrc"
            _git add -A >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            _git commit -q -m "glean: init workspace" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            _git branch -M main >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        fi
        [[ -f "$(_rowid_file)" ]] || echo 1 > "$(_rowid_file)"
        _unlock
    fi
}

# Zero-padded next capture id from the count of existing capture dirs.
_next_capture_id () {
    local dir n; dir="$(_cap_dir)"
    n=$(find "$dir" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    printf 'c%04d\n' "$((n + 1))"
}

# Column overlap (Jaccard, as an integer percent) between two tab-separated
# headers passed as the two lines of stdin.
_col_overlap () {
    awk -F'\t' '
        NR==1 { for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){a[$i]=1}; na=NF }
        NR==2 { for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){ b[$i]=1; if($i in a) inter++ } }
        END { for(k in a) u[k]=1; for(k in b) u[k]=1; nu=0; for(k in u) nu++;
              if(nu==0){print 100; exit} printf "%d\n", int(inter*100/nu) }'
}

# (Header union + row alignment come from the imported transform module:
# _core_union_header "$old" "$new"  and  _core_align_rows "$src" "$tgt" < rows.)

# Append tidy TSV (header+rows) to a dataset file. Store rule:
#   new dataset            Aje28692Aj write header + rows;
#   header matches         Aje28692Aj append data rows;
#   header differs, overlap Aje289a5Aj GLEAN_RECONCILE_OVERLAP% Aje28692Aj RECONCILE: union the
#                            columns, blank-fill both sides, rewrite in place;
#   overlap below threshold Aje28692Aj split into a numbered variant (.v2, .v3, Aje280a6Aj).
# Echoes "<final-dataset-name>\t<row-count>" (single line) on stdout.
_store_append () {
    local name="$1" tsv="$2" dir; dir="$(_ds_dir)"
    local base="$dir/$name.tsv" target="$name" file="$dir/$name.tsv"
    local new_header; new_header="$(printf '%s\n' "$tsv" | head -1)"

    if [[ ! -f "$base" ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$tsv" > "$base"
    else
        local old_header; old_header="$(head -1 "$base")"
        if [[ "$old_header" == "$new_header" ]]; then
            printf '%s\n' "$tsv" | tail -n +2 >> "$base"
        else
            local overlap; overlap="$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$old_header" "$new_header" | _col_overlap)"
            if [[ "$overlap" -ge "$GLEAN_RECONCILE_OVERLAP" ]]; then
                # Reconcile into the base dataset: union header, realign both sides
                # (imported transform helpers).
                local unified tmp; unified="$(_core_union_header "$old_header" "$new_header")"
                tmp="$(mktemp "$dir/.recon.XXXXXX")"
                {
                    printf '%s\n' "$unified"
                    tail -n +2 "$base"                | _core_align_rows "$old_header" "$unified"
                    printf '%s\n' "$tsv" | tail -n +2 | _core_align_rows "$new_header" "$unified"
                } > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$base" || { rm -f "$tmp"; return 1; }
            else
                # Genuinely different shape Aje28692Aj variant file.
                local v=2
                while [[ -f "$dir/$name.v$v.tsv" ]] && \
                      [[ "$(head -1 "$dir/$name.v$v.tsv")" != "$new_header" ]]; do
                    v=$((v+1))
                done
                target="$name.v$v"; file="$dir/$target.tsv"
                if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$tsv" | tail -n +2 >> "$file"
                else printf '%s\n' "$tsv" > "$file"; fi
            fi
        fi
    fi
    local rows; rows=$(( $(wc -l < "$file") - 1 )); [[ $rows -lt 0 ]] && rows=0
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$target" "$rows"
}

# Core ingest pipeline shared by `inject` (pipe/file) and `run` (a command).
#   $1 input file  $2 threshold  $3 source (inject|run)  $4 cmd ("" for inject)
#   $5 rc ("" for inject)
# Extracts Aje28692Aj classifies Aje28692Aj melts Aje28692Aj assigns a global #N to each row Aje28692Aj stores Aje28692Aj
# records provenance (#N Aje28692Aj capture) Aje28692Aj commits, all under the store lock.
_ingest () {
    local in="$1" threshold="$2" source="$3" cmd="${4:-}" rc="${5:-}"
    local engine; engine="$(_find_engine)" \
        || die "extract engine not found (expected at $GLEAN_ROOT/extract/envoy-extract; set GLEAN_HOME to override)."

    local tmp; tmp="$(mktemp -d "$GLEAN_TEMP_DIR/glean.XXXXXX")"
    # shellcheck disable=SC2064
    trap "rm -rf '$tmp'" RETURN

    # A metadata prologue Aje28094Aj a leading run of '#%' lines, as prepended by
    # wrappers like deframe Aje28094Aj is capture context, not data: peel it off before
    # detection so it can never corrupt a parse. The prologue is recorded with
    # the capture (context.txt) and 'glean source' still shows the input
    # verbatim; a '#%' line after the first data line is data, not context.
    local ctxf="$tmp/context.txt" body="$in"
    if [[ "$(head -c 2 "$in" 2>/dev/null)" == '#%' ]]; then
        body="$tmp/body.txt"
        awk -v ctx="$ctxf" \
            '!started && /^#%/ { print > ctx; next } { started=1; print }' \
            "$in" > "$body"
    fi

    local metaf="$tmp/meta.txt" wide meta strategy conf
    # Extra strategy dir (deframe et al.): --plugin-dir / $GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR is
    # forwarded to the engine, which already searches it alongside its own
    # strategies/ and the ~/.mfe/strategies user dir.
    local eargs=()
    if [[ -n "${GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR:-}" ]]; then
        eargs+=(--plugin-dir "$GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR")
    fi
    wide="$(env -u GIT_DIR bash "$engine" --max-input-size "$GLEAN_MAX_INPUT" \
            ${eargs[@]+"${eargs[@]}"} \
            --emit-meta -f tsv --max-strategies 1 "$body" 2>"$metaf")" || true
    meta="$(grep '^__EXTRACT_META__' "$metaf" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || true)"
    strategy="$(printf '%s' "$meta" | awk -F'\t' '{print $2}')"
    conf="$(printf '%s' "$meta" | awk -F'\t' '{print $3}')"
    [[ "$conf" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || conf=0

    # Build the content to file (header + data rows), pre-#-index, for both the
    # matched and the held-back (unsorted) paths.
    local content dsname reason=""
    if [[ -z "$strategy" || -z "$wide" ]]; then reason="no-match"
    elif [[ "$conf" -lt "$threshold" ]]; then reason="low-confidence ($conf<$threshold)"; fi
    if [[ -n "$reason" ]]; then
        dsname="unsorted"; strategy="${strategy:-none}"
        content="$(printf 'raw\n%s' "$(base64 -w0 < "$in" 2>/dev/null || base64 < "$in" | tr -d '\n')")"
    else
        dsname="$strategy"
        content="$(_core_melt_tidy "$wide")"
    fi

    # --- critical section: assign #N, append, provenance, commit -----------
    _lock
    # shellcheck disable=SC2064
    trap "_unlock; rm -rf '$tmp'" RETURN

    local startid nrows fields id capd ts final
    startid="$(cat "$(_rowid_file)" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
    nrows=$(( $(printf '%s\n' "$content" | grep -c .) - 1 )); [[ $nrows -lt 0 ]] && nrows=0

    # Prepend a visible, globally-unique '#' index to the header + each row.
    local idcontent
    idcontent="$(printf '%s\n' "$content" | awk -F'\t' -v OFS='\t' -v s="$startid" '
        NR==1 { print "#", $0; next } { print (s + NR - 2), $0 }')"
    fields=$(printf '%s\n' "$idcontent" | head -1 | awk -F'\t' '{print NF}')

    local result; result="$(_store_append "$dsname" "$idcontent")"
    final="${result%%$'\t'*}"

    id="$(_next_capture_id)"; capd="$(_cap_dir)/$id"; mkdir -p "$capd"
    ts="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
    cp "$in" "$capd/output.txt"
    if [[ -s "$ctxf" ]]; then cp "$ctxf" "$capd/context.txt"; fi
    {
        printf 'id\t%s\n' "$id";            printf 'ts\t%s\n' "$ts"
        printf 'source\t%s\n' "$source";    printf 'command\t%s\n' "$cmd"
        printf 'rc\t%s\n' "$rc";            printf 'strategy\t%s\n' "$strategy"
        printf 'confidence\t%s\n' "$conf";  printf 'dataset\t%s\n' "$final"
        printf 'row_ids\t%s\n' "$([[ $nrows -gt 0 ]] && echo "$startid-$((startid+nrows-1))" || echo none)"
        if [[ -n "${GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR:-}" ]]; then
            printf 'plugin_dir\t%s\n' "$GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR"
        fi
        if [[ -s "$ctxf" ]]; then printf 'context\tcontext.txt\n'; fi
    } > "$capd/meta.tsv"

    # Provenance: one line per row  (#N \t dataset \t capture)
    [[ -f "$(_prov_file)" ]] || printf '#\tdataset\tcapture\n' > "$(_prov_file)"
    local i
    for (( i=0; i<nrows; i++ )); do
        printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$((startid+i))" "$final" "$id" >> "$(_prov_file)"
    done
    echo "$((startid + nrows))" > "$(_rowid_file)"

    # In a controlled directory, snapshot the directory's contents as commit
    # context so the capture is tied to what the tree looked like at the time.
    if [[ "${GLEAN_STORE_KIND:-}" == controlled:* ]]; then
        # Subshell so a set -e abort inside can't escape past the guard.
        ( _snapshot_context "$(dirname "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE")" "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE" ) >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
    _git add -A >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    local msg="capture $id: $source $strategy Aje28692Aj $final (#${startid}..$((startid+nrows-1)))"
    [[ -n "$cmd" ]] && msg="$msg [$cmd]"
    _git commit -q -m "$msg" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    _git tag -f "capture-$id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    _unlock
    # shellcheck disable=SC2064
    trap "rm -rf '$tmp'" RETURN

    local idrange="#${startid}..$((startid+nrows-1))"; [[ $nrows -eq 0 ]] && idrange="(no rows)"
    if [[ -n "$reason" ]]; then
        info "$id: $reason Aje28094Aj queued in 'unsorted' as $idrange (committed)."
    else
        ok "$id: Aje28692Aj dataset '$final' rows $idrange (strategy $strategy, conf $conf) Aje28094Aj $((fields-1)) field(s)."
    fi
}

# Fire-and-forget ingest: spool the input and run _ingest in a detached child so
# the shell prompt returns immediately. This is the DEFAULT for inject/run;
# --sync/--wait (or GLEAN_ASYNC=0) forces the foreground path that prints the
# resulting dataset + #N range instead of returning at once.
# The spool lives OUTSIDE the workspace (so it is never swept into a git commit,
# and survives the parent's tmp cleanup); the child ingests it, and on success
# removes the spool. On failure the spool Aje28094Aj including log.txt Aje28094Aj is kept so the
# error is inspectable. Store serialisation is unchanged: the child takes the
# same _lock as any writer, so concurrent async captures stay consistent.
_ingest_async () {
    local in="$1" threshold="$2" source="$3" cmd="${4:-}" rc="${5:-}"
    local spool; spool="$(mktemp -d "$GLEAN_TEMP_DIR/glean-async.XXXXXX")"
    cp "$in" "$spool/in.txt"
    (
        trap '' HUP                                   # survive the shell exiting
        if _ingest "$spool/in.txt" "$threshold" "$source" "$cmd" "$rc" \
               >"$spool/log.txt" 2>&1; then
            rm -rf "$spool"
        fi                                            # keep spool+log on failure
    ) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
    disown 2>/dev/null || true
    info "queued (async, pid $!) Aje28094Aj capturing in the background; see 'glean log' shortly."
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Default verb: inject (pipe or file)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cmd_inject () {
    local file="" threshold="$GLEAN_MIN_CONFIDENCE" async="${GLEAN_ASYNC:-1}"
    while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
        case "$1" in
            -q|--silent) GLEAN_QUIET=1; shift ;;
            --min-confidence) threshold="${2:?--min-confidence needs a number}"; shift 2 ;;
            --plugin-dir) GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR="${2:?--plugin-dir needs a directory}"; shift 2 ;;
            --async) async=1; shift ;;
            --sync|--wait) async=0; shift ;;
            -h|--help) cmd_help; return 0 ;;
            -*) die "unknown option: $1" ;;
            *) file="$1"; shift ;;
        esac
    done
    if [[ -n "${GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR:-}" && ! -d "$GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR" ]]; then
        die "plugin strategy dir not found: $GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR"
    fi

    _ensure_workspace
    local tmp; tmp="$(mktemp -d "$GLEAN_TEMP_DIR/glean.XXXXXX")"
    # shellcheck disable=SC2064
    trap "rm -rf '$tmp'" EXIT INT TERM
    local in="$tmp/in.txt"
    if [[ -n "$file" ]]; then
        [[ -f "$file" ]] || die "no such file: $file"
        tr -d '\r' < "$file" > "$in"
    else
        head -c "$((GLEAN_MAX_INPUT + 1))" | tr -d '\r' > "$in"
    fi
    [[ -s "$in" ]] || die "no input to glean (empty)."
    [[ "$(wc -c < "$in")" -le "$GLEAN_MAX_INPUT" ]] \
        || die "input too large (max $GLEAN_MAX_INPUT bytes; raise GLEAN_MAX_INPUT)."

    if [[ "$async" -eq 1 ]]; then _ingest_async "$in" "$threshold" "inject" "" ""
    else _ingest "$in" "$threshold" "inject" "" ""; fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# run Aje28094Aj execute a command, capture its output as a commit, and ingest it.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cmd_run () {
    local threshold="$GLEAN_MIN_CONFIDENCE" async="${GLEAN_ASYNC:-1}"
    while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
        case "$1" in
            -q|--silent) GLEAN_QUIET=1; shift ;;
            --min-confidence) threshold="${2:?--min-confidence needs a number}"; shift 2 ;;
            --plugin-dir) GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR="${2:?--plugin-dir needs a directory}"; shift 2 ;;
            --async) async=1; shift ;;
            --sync|--wait) async=0; shift ;;
            -h|--help) cmd_help; return 0 ;;
            --) shift; break ;;
            -*) die "unknown option: $1" ;;
            *) break ;;
        esac
    done
    [[ $# -gt 0 ]] || die "usage: glean run [--] <command> [args...]"
    if [[ -n "${GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR:-}" && ! -d "$GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR" ]]; then
        die "plugin strategy dir not found: $GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR"
    fi

    _ensure_workspace
    local tmp; tmp="$(mktemp -d "$GLEAN_TEMP_DIR/glean.XXXXXX")"
    # shellcheck disable=SC2064
    trap "rm -rf '$tmp'" EXIT INT TERM
    local in="$tmp/in.txt" rc=0
    # Capture combined stdout+stderr (the thing you'd otherwise eyeball).
    "$@" > "$in" 2>&1 || rc=$?
    tr -d '\r' < "$in" > "$in.clean" && mv "$in.clean" "$in"
    local cmd="$*"
    [[ -s "$in" ]] || { info "command produced no output (rc=$rc) Aje28094Aj nothing captured."; return "$rc"; }
    if [[ "$async" -eq 1 ]]; then _ingest_async "$in" "$threshold" "run" "$cmd" "$rc"
    else _ingest "$in" "$threshold" "run" "$cmd" "$rc"; fi
    return "$rc"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# log / restore Aje28094Aj the git core: list captures, bring one back up.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cmd_log () {
    _ensure_workspace
    shopt -s nullglob
    local d id ts src strat ds rc any=0
    printf '%-6s %-20s %-7s %-14s %-12s %s\n' "ID" "WHEN" "SOURCE" "STRATEGY" "DATASET" "COMMAND" >&2
    for d in $(printf '%s\n' "$(_cap_dir)"/*/ | sort); do
        [[ -f "$d/meta.tsv" ]] || continue
        any=1
        id=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="id"{print $2}' "$d/meta.tsv")
        ts=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="ts"{print $2}' "$d/meta.tsv")
        src=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="source"{print $2}' "$d/meta.tsv")
        strat=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="strategy"{print $2}' "$d/meta.tsv")
        ds=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="dataset"{print $2}' "$d/meta.tsv")
        local cmd; cmd=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="command"{print $2}' "$d/meta.tsv")
        printf '%-6s %-20s %-7s %-14s %-12s %s\n' "$id" "$ts" "$src" "$strat" "$ds" "$cmd"
    done
    [[ $any -eq 1 ]] || info "no captures yet Aje28094Aj run 'glean run <cmd>' or pipe into 'glean'."
}

cmd_restore () {
    _ensure_workspace
    local target="${1:?usage: glean restore <capture-id|latest>}"
    if [[ "$target" == "latest" ]]; then
        _git checkout -q main 2>/dev/null \
            && ok "restored workspace to latest (main)." \
            || die "could not return to latest."
        return 0
    fi
    [[ "$target" == capture-* ]] || target="capture-$target"
    _git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/$target" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
        || die "no such capture: ${target#capture-} (see 'glean log')."
    # Bring that capture's committed tree back up (detached).
    _git checkout -q "$target" 2>/dev/null \
        || die "checkout failed for $target."
    ok "brought up ${target#capture-} (detached). Return with: glean restore latest"
    local capd; capd="$(_cap_dir)/${target#capture-}"
    [[ -f "$capd/meta.tsv" ]] && { echo; sed 's/\t/: /' "$capd/meta.tsv"; }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# control / uncontrol / instances Aje28094Aj a directory as its own capture instance.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
_registry () { printf '%s/instances.tsv\n' "$(_default_home)"; }

# Snapshot the controlled directory's contents as commit context: a manifest of
# path/size/mtime/sha for each file (excluding the .glean instance and .git).
_snapshot_context () {
    local dir="$1" ws="$2" mani="$ws/context/manifest.tsv" f sz mt sha
    mkdir -p "$ws/context"
    printf 'path\tsize\tmtime\tsha1\n' > "$mani"
    while IFS= read -r f; do
        sz=$(stat -c '%s' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        mt=$(stat -c '%Y' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [[ "$sz" -le 1048576 ]] && command -v sha1sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sha=$(sha1sum "$f" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)
        else sha="(skipped)"; fi
        printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "${f#"$dir"/}" "$sz" "$mt" "$sha" >> "$mani"
    done < <(find "$dir" -type f -not -path '*/.glean/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' 2>/dev/null | sort)
    local n; n=$(( $(wc -l < "$mani") - 1 ))
    printf '%s\n' "$n"
}

cmd_control () {
    local dir="${1:-$PWD}"
    dir="$(cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || die "no such directory: ${1:-$PWD}"
    local ws="$dir/.glean"
    if [[ -f "$ws/CONTROLLED" ]]; then info "already controlled: $dir"; return 0; fi
    # Point this invocation's store at the new instance and initialise it.
    GLEAN_WORKSPACE="$ws"; GLEAN_STORE_KIND="controlled: $dir"; GLEAN_WORKSPACE_EXPLICIT=1
    _ensure_workspace
    printf '%s\n' "$dir" > "$ws/CONTROLLED"
    local n; n="$(_snapshot_context "$dir" "$ws")"
    _lock
    _git add -A >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    _git commit -q -m "glean: control $dir (context: $n file(s))" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    _unlock
    # Register in the global store so `glean instances` (run anywhere) sees it.
    mkdir -p "$(_default_home)"
    [[ -f "$(_registry)" ]] || printf 'directory\tcontrolled_at\n' > "$(_registry)"
    grep -qxF "$dir	$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$(_registry)" 2>/dev/null || \
        printf '%s\t%s\n' "$dir" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$(_registry)"
    ok "controlling '$dir' Aje28094Aj captures run here now route to $ws (context: $n file(s))."
}

cmd_uncontrol () {
    local dir="${1:-$PWD}"
    dir="$(cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || die "no such directory: ${1:-$PWD}"
    [[ -f "$dir/.glean/CONTROLLED" ]] || die "not a controlled directory: $dir"
    rm -f "$dir/.glean/CONTROLLED"
    if [[ -f "$(_registry)" ]]; then
        grep -v "^$dir	" "$(_registry)" > "$(_registry).tmp" 2>/dev/null && mv "$(_registry).tmp" "$(_registry)" || true
    fi
    ok "released '$dir' (its .glean data is kept; captures here revert to the global store)."
}

cmd_instances () {
    local reg; reg="$(_registry)"
    [[ -f "$reg" ]] || { info "no controlled directories yet Aje28094Aj 'glean control <dir>'."; return 0; }
    local n; n=$(( $(wc -l < "$reg") - 1 )); [[ $n -lt 0 ]] && n=0
    [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { info "no controlled directories yet Aje28094Aj 'glean control <dir>'."; return 0; }
    printf '%-40s %-20s %s\n' "DIRECTORY" "CONTROLLED_AT" "ACTIVE" >&2
    local d t
    while IFS=$'\t' read -r d t; do
        [[ "$d" == "directory" ]] && continue
        printf '%-40s %-20s %s\n' "$d" "$t" "$([[ -f "$d/.glean/CONTROLLED" ]] && echo yes || echo released)"
    done < "$reg"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# export / import Aje28094Aj a portable bundle of the whole store (datasets + commits).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cmd_export () {
    _ensure_workspace
    local out="${1:-}"
    if [[ -z "$out" ]]; then out="$PWD/glean-export-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).bundle"; fi
    _git rev-parse HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "nothing to export Aje28094Aj store has no commits yet."
    _lock
    local rc=0
    _git bundle create "$out" --all >/dev/null 2>&1 || rc=$?
    _unlock
    [[ $rc -eq 0 && -f "$out" ]] || die "export failed."
    local sz; sz=$(stat -c '%s' "$out" 2>/dev/null || echo '?')
    ok "exported store Aje28692Aj $out ($sz bytes). Import elsewhere with: glean import $out <dest>"
}

cmd_import () {
    local file="${1:?usage: glean import <file.bundle> [<dest-dir>]}"
    [[ -f "$file" ]] || die "no such export file: $file"
    local dest="${2:-}"
    [[ -z "$dest" ]] && dest="$PWD/glean-import-$(basename "$file" .bundle)"
    [[ -e "$dest" ]] && die "destination already exists: $dest"
    git bundle verify "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "not a valid glean export bundle: $file"
    git clone -q "$file" "$dest" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "import (clone) failed."
    git -C "$dest" checkout -q main >/dev/null 2>&1 || git -C "$dest" checkout -q master >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    local nds ncap
    nds=$(find "$dest/datasets" -name '*.tsv' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    ncap=$(find "$dest/captures" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    ok "imported Aje28692Aj $dest ($nds dataset(s), $ncap capture(s))."
    info "browse it with: GLEAN_WORKSPACE='$dest' glean ls   (or show/log/source/restore)"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# source Aje28094Aj given a dataset row's #N index, show the original captured input.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cmd_source () {
    _ensure_workspace
    local n="${1:?usage: glean source <#N>}"
    n="${n#\#}"                                   # tolerate a leading '#'
    [[ "$n" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "row index must be a number (got '$n')."
    local prov; prov="$(_prov_file)"
    [[ -f "$prov" ]] || die "no provenance yet Aje28094Aj capture something first."
    local line; line="$(awk -F'\t' -v n="$n" '$1==n {print; exit}' "$prov")"
    [[ -n "$line" ]] || die "no row #$n (see 'glean ls' / 'glean show <dataset>')."
    local ds cap; ds="$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -f2)"; cap="$(printf '%s' "$line" | cut -f3)"
    local capd; capd="$(_cap_dir)/$cap"

    info "row #$n Aje28094Aj dataset '$ds', from capture $cap"
    if [[ -f "$capd/meta.tsv" ]]; then
        echo; sed 's/\t/: /' "$capd/meta.tsv"
    fi
    if [[ -f "$capd/output.txt" ]]; then
        echo; printf '%s----- original source (capture %s) -----%s\n' "$C_DIM" "$cap" "$C_RST"
        cat "$capd/output.txt"
    else
        die "capture $cap has no stored output (workspace may be detached Aje28094Aj try 'glean restore latest')."
    fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# stats Aje28094Aj statistics on a dataset (the bundled analyze engine).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cmd_stats () {
    local name="${1:?usage: glean stats <dataset> [analyze-args...]}"; shift || true
    local f; f="$(_ds_dir)/$name.tsv"
    [[ -f "$f" ]] || die "no such dataset: $name (try 'glean ls')."
    local analyze; analyze="$(_find_analyze)" \
        || die "analyze engine not found (expected at $GLEAN_ROOT/analyze/envoy-analyze)."
    # Datasets are TSV; suppress the gawk-preference banner. Extra args pass
    # straight through (e.g. --all, a numbered analysis list, --format json).
    ENVOY_ANALYZE_SUPPRESS_AWK_WARNING=1 env -u GIT_DIR bash "$analyze" "$f" "$@"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ls / show / triage / doctor
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cmd_ls () {
    local dir; dir="$(_ds_dir)"
    [[ -d "$dir" ]] || { info "no datasets yet Aje28094Aj pipe something into 'glean'."; return 0; }
    shopt -s nullglob
    local f name rows any=0
    printf '%-24s %8s\n' "DATASET" "ROWS" >&2
    for f in "$dir"/*.tsv; do
        any=1; name="$(basename "$f" .tsv)"
        rows=$(( $(wc -l < "$f") - 1 )); [[ $rows -lt 0 ]] && rows=0
        printf '%-24s %8d\n' "$name" "$rows"
    done
    [[ $any -eq 1 ]] || info "no datasets yet Aje28094Aj pipe something into 'glean'."
}

# The 'unsorted' dataset holds each held-back capture as a single base64-encoded
# 'raw' column (see _ingest). Decode it back to text for display, escaping any
# embedded tabs/newlines so each captured input stays on one line of the table.
# 'glean source #N' remains the way back to the exact original bytes.
_decode_unsorted_tsv () {
    local f="$1" n b64 decoded
    printf '#\traw\n'
    tail -n +2 "$f" | while IFS=$'\t' read -r n b64; do
        decoded="$(printf '%s' "$b64" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$b64")"
        decoded="${decoded//$'\t'/\\t}"
        decoded="${decoded//$'\n'/\\n}"
        printf '%s\t%s\n' "$n" "$decoded"
    done
}

cmd_show () {
    local name="${1:?usage: glean show NAME}"
    local f; f="$(_ds_dir)/$name.tsv"
    [[ -f "$f" ]] || die "no such dataset: $name (try 'glean ls')."
    if [[ "$name" == "unsorted" ]]; then
        if command -v column >/dev/null 2>&1; then _decode_unsorted_tsv "$f" | column -t -s $'\t'
        else _decode_unsorted_tsv "$f"; fi
    elif command -v column >/dev/null 2>&1; then column -t -s $'\t' "$f"
    else cat "$f"; fi
}

cmd_triage () {
    local f; f="$(_ds_dir)/unsorted.tsv"
    [[ -f "$f" ]] || { info "triage queue empty Aje28094Aj nothing unmatched."; return 0; }
    info "unsorted rows (low-confidence / no-match), raw input decoded ('glean source #N' for exact bytes):"
    if command -v column >/dev/null 2>&1; then _decode_unsorted_tsv "$f" | column -t -s $'\t'
    else _decode_unsorted_tsv "$f"; fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# rm Aje28094Aj delete one or more datasets, provenance-aware, tracked as a commit.
#   glean rm [-f|--yes] [--no-purge] <dataset> [<dataset>...]
# Removes each dataset file (only the named dataset Aje28094Aj variants like NAME.v2 are
# their own datasets, remove them by name), prunes the matching rows from
# provenance.tsv, and Aje28094Aj BY DEFAULT Aje28094Aj purges the captures/<id>/ dirs that fed the
# removed dataset(s) too (--no-purge / --keep-captures keeps them). The deletion
# is committed, so the git history (and 'glean restore') still holds the
# pre-deletion state. Row indices (#N) are never reused.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cmd_rm () {
    _ensure_workspace
    local yes=0 purge=1 names=()
    while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
        case "$1" in
            -f|--yes|--force)        yes=1; shift ;;
            --purge)                 purge=1; shift ;;
            --no-purge|--keep-captures) purge=0; shift ;;
            -h|--help)               cmd_help; return 0 ;;
            --)                      shift; while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do names+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
            -*)                      die "unknown option: $1" ;;
            *)                       names+=("$1"); shift ;;
        esac
    done
    [[ ${#names[@]} -gt 0 ]] || die "usage: glean rm [-f] [--no-purge] <dataset> [<dataset>...]"

    local dir; dir="$(_ds_dir)"
    # Validate every name up front Aje28094Aj refuse the whole operation if any is missing.
    local n missing=()
    for n in "${names[@]}"; do
        [[ -f "$dir/$n.tsv" ]] || missing+=("$n")
    done
    [[ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ]] || die "no such dataset: ${missing[*]} (try 'glean ls')."

    # Confirm (unless -f), reporting how many rows go with the datasets.
    local total=0 rows
    for n in "${names[@]}"; do
        rows=$(( $(wc -l < "$dir/$n.tsv") - 1 )); [[ $rows -lt 0 ]] && rows=0
        total=$((total + rows))
    done
    if [[ $yes -ne 1 ]]; then
        printf 'About to delete %d dataset(s), %d row(s): %s\n' "${#names[@]}" "$total" "${names[*]}" >&2
        if [[ $purge -eq 1 ]]; then
            printf 'Also purging the captures that fed them Aje28094Aj originals removed (--no-purge to keep them).\n' >&2
        else
            printf 'Keeping the source captures (--no-purge).\n' >&2
        fi
        printf '%s' 'Proceed? [y/N] ' >&2
        local ans=""; read -r ans || ans=""
        case "$ans" in y|Y|yes|YES|Yes) ;; *) info "aborted Aje28094Aj nothing deleted."; return 0 ;; esac
    fi

    _lock
    # shellcheck disable=SC2064
    trap "_unlock" RETURN

    # A one-name-per-line file drives the awk/loop membership tests.
    local tmp; tmp="$(mktemp "$dir/.rm.XXXXXX")"
    printf '%s\n' "${names[@]}" > "$tmp"

    # Drop the dataset files.
    for n in "${names[@]}"; do rm -f "$dir/$n.tsv"; done

    # Prune provenance rows whose dataset was removed (keep the header).
    local prov ptmp; prov="$(_prov_file)"
    if [[ -f "$prov" ]]; then
        ptmp="$(mktemp "$dir/.rmprov.XXXXXX")"
        awk -F'\t' '
            NR==FNR { del[$0]=1; next }
            FNR==1  { print; next }
            !($2 in del) { print }
        ' "$tmp" "$prov" > "$ptmp" && mv "$ptmp" "$prov" || { rm -f "$ptmp"; }
    fi

    # --purge: remove the capture dirs (and their tags) that fed a removed
    # dataset, identified by each capture's own meta 'dataset' field.
    local purged=0 d cid cds
    if [[ $purge -eq 1 ]]; then
        for d in "$(_cap_dir)"/*/; do
            [[ -f "$d/meta.tsv" ]] || continue
            cds=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="dataset"{print $2}' "$d/meta.tsv")
            if grep -qxF "$cds" "$tmp"; then
                cid=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="id"{print $2}' "$d/meta.tsv")
                rm -rf "$d"
                [[ -n "$cid" ]] && _git tag -d "capture-$cid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
                purged=$((purged + 1))
            fi
        done
    fi
    rm -f "$tmp"

    _git add -A >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    local msg="rm: deleted ${#names[@]} dataset(s) [${names[*]}], pruned $total row(s)"
    [[ $purge -eq 1 ]] && msg="$msg, purged $purged capture(s)"
    _git commit -q -m "$msg" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    _unlock
    # shellcheck disable=SC2064
    trap - RETURN

    if [[ $purge -eq 1 ]]; then
        ok "deleted ${names[*]} (${total} row(s)); purged $purged capture(s). History kept Aje28094Aj 'glean log'/'restore' still reach the pre-deletion state."
    else
        ok "deleted ${names[*]} (${total} row(s)); source captures kept (--no-purge). 'glean source #N' still resolves surviving rows."
    fi
}

cmd_doctor () {
    local engine
    if engine="$(_find_engine)"; then
        printf '%s ok%s extract engine: %s\n' "$C_OK" "$C_RST" "$engine"
        # The bundled engine is the canonical one. If we resolved a different one
        # (a $GLEAN_HOME/extract/ override), warn Aje28094Aj a stale copy there silently
        # shadows the bundled engine and can misclassify inputs.
        if [[ "$engine" != "$GLEAN_ROOT/extract/envoy-extract" ]]; then
            printf '   %swarning%s using an engine from GLEAN_HOME, not the bundled one\n' "$C_ERR" "$C_RST"
            printf '            bundled: %s\n' "$GLEAN_ROOT/extract/envoy-extract"
            printf '            if this is a stale copy, remove it or unset GLEAN_HOME.\n'
        fi
    else
        printf '%serror%s extract engine not found\n' "$C_ERR" "$C_RST"; return 1
    fi
    local analyze
    if analyze="$(_find_analyze)"; then
        printf '%s ok%s analyze engine: %s\n' "$C_OK" "$C_RST" "$analyze"
        command -v gawk >/dev/null 2>&1 || printf '   note: gawk not found; analyze uses %s (some analyses may degrade)\n' "$(awk --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo awk)"
    else
        printf '   analyze engine not found (expected at %s/analyze/)\n' "$GLEAN_ROOT"
    fi
    printf '   store: %s (%s)' "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE" "${GLEAN_STORE_KIND:-global}"
    [[ -d "$GLEAN_WORKSPACE/.git" ]] && printf ' [git-backed]'; printf '\n'
    if [[ -f "$(_rowid_file)" ]]; then
        printf '   next row index: #%s\n' "$(cat "$(_rowid_file)")"
    fi
    printf '   min-confidence: %s\n' "$GLEAN_MIN_CONFIDENCE"
}

cmd_help () {
    cat >&2 <<EOF
glean $GLEAN_VERSION Aje28094Aj turn command output into data

USAGE
    glean run [--] <cmd> [args...]                capture a command's output as a
                                                 commit, auto-detect + file it
    cmd | glean [--silent] [--min-confidence N]   inject stdin into a typed dataset Aje28094Aj
                [--sync] [--plugin-dir DIR]        captures in the BACKGROUND by default;
                                                 --sync/--wait to file it in the foreground;
                                                 --plugin-dir adds an extra strategy dir
    glean [FILE]                                  inject a file instead of stdin
    glean source <#N>                             show the original source behind row #N
    glean control [<dir>]                         make <dir> its own capture instance
    glean uncontrol [<dir>]                        release a controlled directory
    glean instances                               list controlled directories
    glean export [<file>]                         bundle the store into a portable file
    glean import <file> [<dest>]                   reconstitute a bundle elsewhere to browse
    glean log                                     list captures (the git history)
    glean restore <id|latest>                     bring a capture's commit back up
    glean ls                                      list datasets
    glean show NAME                               present a dataset (leading #N = row index)
    glean rm [-f] [--no-purge] NAME...            delete dataset(s) + their captures (--no-purge keeps captures)
    glean stats NAME [analyze-args]               statistics on a dataset (--all for everything)
    glean triage                                  show low-confidence / unmatched bucket (raw input decoded)
    glean doctor                                  check engine + store
    glean help

STORE (global by default, or a controlled directory)
    Captures go to a GLOBAL git store so you can capture from any directory:
      \$GLEAN_HOME, or ~/.glean if unset. Point GLEAN_HOME at a shared,
      group-writable dir to collaborate; a lock serialises concurrent writers.
    'glean control <dir>' makes <dir> its own instance (<dir>/.glean): captures
    run inside it (or a subdir) route there, and each commit snapshots the
    directory's contents as context. Resolution: GLEAN_WORKSPACE override, else
    the nearest controlled dir walking up from CWD, else the global store.
    Every capture is one commit tagged capture-<id> ('log' / 'restore'). Every
    dataset row has a globally-unique visible index #N; 'glean source N' maps it
    back to the exact captured input that produced it.

ENV
    GLEAN_HOME            global store dir (default: ~/.glean)
    GLEAN_WORKSPACE       explicit store override (wins over GLEAN_HOME)
    GLEAN_MIN_CONFIDENCE  commit threshold 0-100 (default: 50)
    GLEAN_PLUGIN_DIR      extra strategy dir for detection (same as --plugin-dir
                          on inject/run; for wrappers like deframe Aje28094Aj no
                          ~/.mfe/strategies symlink needed)
    GLEAN_ASYNC          background capture (default 1; set 0 or use --sync for foreground)
    GLEAN_MAX_INPUT       max input bytes (default: 10485760)
    GLEAN_LOCK_TIMEOUT    seconds to wait for the store lock (default: 30)

METADATA PROLOGUE
    A leading run of '#%' lines on injected input is treated as capture context,
    not data: it is peeled off before format detection (so it cannot corrupt a
    parse), stored with the capture (context.txt), and shown verbatim by
    'glean source'. Wrappers can prepend context unconditionally.

Not yet in this prototype (proposal 0001): schema reconciliation (a differing
column set currently splits a dataset into a numbered variant, e.g. free.v2).
See docs/proposals/0001-glean-rename-and-simplification.md.
EOF
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dispatch Aje28094Aj bare invocation (or a leading option / FILE) means inject.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
main () {
    local verb="${1:-}"
    case "$verb" in
        run)           shift; cmd_run "$@" ;;
        source|src)    shift; cmd_source "$@" ;;
        control)       shift; cmd_control "$@" ;;
        uncontrol)     shift; cmd_uncontrol "$@" ;;
        instances)     shift; cmd_instances "$@" ;;
        export)        shift; cmd_export "$@" ;;
        import)        shift; cmd_import "$@" ;;
        log)           shift; cmd_log "$@" ;;
        restore)       shift; cmd_restore "$@" ;;
        ls)            shift; cmd_ls "$@" ;;
        show)          shift; cmd_show "$@" ;;
        rm|delete|drop) shift; cmd_rm "$@" ;;
        stats)         shift; cmd_stats "$@" ;;
        triage)        shift; cmd_triage "$@" ;;
        doctor)        shift; cmd_doctor "$@" ;;
        help|-h|--help) cmd_help ;;
        -V|--version)  printf 'glean %s\n' "$GLEAN_VERSION" ;;
        inject)        shift; cmd_inject "$@" ;;   # explicit alias
        *)             cmd_inject "$@" ;;          # default verb
    esac
}
main "$@"
